title: Arsenal Roulette

body: Arsenal Roulette is a NeoForge mod that adds an Arsenal Dungeons Forge for rolling dungeon-style perks onto weapons, armor, and books. Players build the forge using the Assembly Table, power it with resources, and use the results in combat with custom effects, animations, and anvil-supported perk book transfers.(read guidebook)
